A '''Mouse Trap''' is an {{Epic}} item.

== Obtaining ==
'''Mouse Traps''' can be purchased from {{NPCSprite|Pesthunter Phillip}} for {{Pests|75}} and a {{Item|Pest Trap}}.

== Usage ==
'''Mouse Traps''' can be placed in [[The Garden#Plots|Garden Plots]] to occasionally catch [[Pests]]. Up to {{Green|3}} '''Mouse Traps''' can be placed at once. Pest baits can be placed inside to increase the chance of certain [[Pest]]s spawning. Every [[Pest]] that spawns in a trap consumes one Pest Bait.

* {{Item|Compost}} attracts {{MobSprite|Mosquito;Mosquitos}} and {{MobSprite|Earthworm;Earthworms}}.
* {{Item|Plant Matter}} attracts {{MobSprite|Locust;Locusts}} and {{MobSprite|Slug;Slugs}}.
* {{Item|Dung}} attracts {{MobSprite|Beetle;Beetles}} and {{MobSprite|Fly;Flies}}.
* {{Item|Honey Jar}}s attract {{MobSprite|Moth;Moths}} and {{MobSprite|Cricket;Crickets}}.
* {{Item|Tasty Cheese}} attracts {{MobSprite|Rat;Rats}} and {{MobSprite|Mite;Mites}}.
* {{Item|Jelly}} attracts {{MobSprite|Dragonfly;Dragonflies}} (only during the day), {{MobSprite|Firefly;Fireflies}} (only during the night), and {{MobSprite|Praying Mantis;Praying Mantises}}.
* {{Item|Moondew}} guarantees catching {{MobSprite|Lunar Moth;Lunar Moths}}.

Additionally, {{Item|Field Mouse|text=Field Mice}} are {{Green|3x}} more likely to be caught.
